title: If you love Architecture and History…
text: The history of Barcelona through architecture - a fascinating and rewarding learning experience. Without our guide Leonardo, we would have missed most of the nuance and looked at the obvious and said “ooh, pretty.”  Instead we got the details that make a city come to life.

title: Exceptional Guide and Awesome Photo Spots
text: Leonardo is an exceptional guide, he is well versed in the history of the area. I felt like we're getting the inside scoop on the history of not only the Sagrada Familia Church, but Barcelona as well. He also showed us the best photo spots! I highly recommend Leonardo!
author: Stephen_B

title: Grateful history!
text: Leonardo was an excellent guide and historian. We learned very much from our experience. I would highly recommend him!
author: Joseph_F

title: History comes to life
text: While it was too late to get tickets inside the church, our tour guide, Leo, made it memorable and shared great stories about the Gaudi architecture that really brought the experience to life. Thank you for helping make my few hours in Barcelona feel full!
